metadata.article_title: Revocation of continuing guarantee by change in firm.

article.title: Revocation of continuing guarantee by change in firm.
article.content: A continuing guarantee given to a firm, or to a third party in respect of the transactions of a firm, is, in the absence of agreement to the contrary, revoked as to future transactions from the date of any change in the constitution of the firm.
article.html:
38Revocation of continuing guarantee by change in firm.

Section 38 · Chapter V · page 10 of the Act

A continuing guarantee given to a firm, or to a third party in respect of the transactions of a firm, is, in the absence of agreement to the contrary, revoked as to future transactions from the date of any change in the constitution of the firm.
